scripts.build: node packages/tokens/src/generate.mjs && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.types.json
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm fixtures && node --test fixtures/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.registry:build: node registry/scripts/validate-metadata.mjs && shadcn build registry.json --output registry/dist
scripts.test:browser: pnpm build && pnpm fixtures && playwright test
scripts.registry:fixtures: pnpm build && pnpm registry:build && node registry/scripts/install-fixtures.mjs
